procedure: cargo test -p cw-core -p cw-data, then cargo test --workspace. The ledger tests encode the borrowing/repayment, capex/CIP/completion, inventory purchase and sale, negative-cash rejection, unbalanced-transaction rejection, journal compaction and chart-balance fixtures. The farm worked example is recomputed independently from content/initial-balance.json in cw-data.
artifacts: crates/cw-core/src/money.rs (half-even rounding, largest-remainder allocation, sub-cent carry tests)
crates/cw-core/src/ledger.rs (balanced postings, borrowing, capex, inventory, compaction tests)
limitations: Covers the ledger oracle only. It does not prove any market, labour, corporate or release behaviour.
